objective: Prove that every resolution refutation of the octahedral knot sphere K_k has width at least c*k: Duplicator answers from label states whose vortex lies outside the density-bad set of the pebbles; the label-state window criterion turns any obstruction to moving the vortex into a closed walk through pebbles of length at most 15 per pebble, and a Vitali covering bounds the bad set by O(pebbles^2). Check the window criterion against a solver and simulate the pebble game.
status: Proved (SPHERE-WIDTH-20261107-001A-P001): the sphere's count needs resolution width Theta(sqrt n). Every refutation of the octahedral knot sphere K_k has width at least c*k - 1, and O(k) suffices. Duplicator answers from label states whose vortex avoids the density-bad set of the pebbles (points with at least s/C pebbles within distance s); by the exact window criterion an obstruction is a negative cycle of a sheet system, closing into a walk of length at most 27 per pebble that separates the two positions or passes through the old one, so a position must be bad, and a Vitali covering bounds the bad set by O(pebbles^2). Checks: criterion = solver 216/216; 190 certificates satisfy L <= 3r - 6 + H and separate (max L/r 5.5); a simulated game survives with up to 12 pebbles on K_6, K_8. Winding bound and isoperimetric constant by sketch.
title: The sphere's count needs width Theta(sqrt n)
